# SlimTide™

> SlimTide™ is a dietary supplement formulated with prebiotic fibers, resistant starch, and probiotic cultures designed to support digestive wellness, gut microbiome balance, metabolic health, and overall well-being.

## Product Summary

SlimTide™ is a daily wellness supplement that combines prebiotic fibers and probiotic strains to support digestive comfort, healthy gut flora, microbiome balance, and metabolic wellness. The formula is designed to complement a balanced diet and active lifestyle.

## Key Ingredients

- Chicory Root Inulin (Prebiotic Fiber)
- Potato Resistant Starch
- Multi-Strain Probiotic Blend

## Intended Benefits

- Supports digestive wellness
- Promotes gut microbiome balance
- Supports healthy metabolic function
- Encourages digestive comfort
- Supports appetite awareness
- Complements healthy lifestyle habits
